name: Action
summary: A button that triggers a host capability.

label.description: Verb-first label saying what happens ('Send £20', not 'OK')

description.description: A second line under the label saying what the action does, for menu-like actions

copy.description: For the renderer action ui.copy: the text put on the clipboard; otherwise the action context's 'text' is copied

whenToUse: Anything the user can do that isn't typing or choosing
whenNotToUse: Confirming something destructive: wrap in Confirm
rendering: At most one primary action visible at a time
'description' sits under the label in type.body.small, muted; the button's accessible description
ui.copy is handled by the renderer: it copies 'copy' (or the context's 'text') and announces 'Copied' politely
